purpose: Explicit, testable circuit breakers. Each trigger is evaluable against .orchestration/runs/<WORK-ID>/status.json and its evidence records. Agents MUST NOT edit this file to get past a breaker.
enforcement_note: No runtime evaluates these today. Triggers are written to be checkable so that a future deterministic check can prove a breaker stops execution. That proof does not exist yet.

breakers.trips_when: two consecutive attempts share an unchanged failure signal
an agent claim of PASS conflicts with an evidence record showing FAIL, or cites evidence that does not exist
an action matches a gate in gates.json
a required handoff field is missing, or references an evidence path that does not exist
